mapper.sql: id, order_no, request_id, user_id, store_id, bay_id, worker_id, service_sku_id, service_level, service_mode, fulfill_mode, status, paid_amount, platform_subsidy, store_bay_fee, insurance_fee, advance_amount, labor_income, pass_through_cost, platform_fee, worker_net, store_net, rating, env_flag, remark, price_snapshot, rate_snapshot, card_snapshot, address_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM t_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, request_id, user_id, store_id, bay_id, service_sku_id, service_level, service_mode, fulfill_mode, status, paid_amount, platform_subsidy, store_bay_fee, insurance_fee, advance_amount, env_flag, remark, price_snapshot, rate_snapshot, card_snapshot, address_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, #{bayId}, #{serviceSkuId}, #{serviceLevel}, #{serviceMode}, #{fulfillMode}, #{status}, #{paidAmount}, #{platformSubsidy}, #{storeBayFee}, #{insuranceFee}, #{advanceAmount}, #{envFlag}, #{remark}, #{priceSnapshot}, #{rateSnapshot}, #{cardSnapshot}, #{addressId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_order SET bay_id = #{bayId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_order SET worker_id = #{workerId}, status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND worker_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE t_order SET labor_income = #{laborIncome}, pass_through_cost = #{passThroughCost}, platform_fee = #{platformFee}, worker_net = #{workerNet}, store_net = #{storeNet}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
